claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor respiratory status, including ABG and ventilator parameters.
Continue sedation with fentanyl and propofol infusions to maintain goal RASS -1, and monitor sedation level.
Monitor and manage severe metabolic acidosis with elevated lactate; consider serial lactate and ABG checks and evaluate for underlying causes.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR, PT, PTT, fibrinogen, platelets) given coagulopathy and thrombocytopenia; assess bleeding risk.
Monitor liver function tests and bilirubin given hyperbilirubinemia and elevated transaminases.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit and assess need for transfusion given anemia.
Monitor electrolytes (ionized calcium, magnesium, potassium) and replace as needed.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment to evaluate readiness for extubation.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and monitor for GI bleeding given coagulopathy and mechanical ventilation.
Provide venous thromboembolism prophylaxis, considering bleeding risk, and monitor.
